mapper.update: update SYS_SEQ t1 using ( select #{seqcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} seqcode, #{seqdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} from sysibm.SYSDUMMY1 ) t2 on (t1.SEQCODE=t2.SEQCODE and t1.SEQDATE=t2.seqdate) when not matched then insert into SYS_SEQ ( SEQCODE, SEQDATE, SEQVALUE, REMARK ) values ( #{seqdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seqcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seqvalue,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) when matched then update SYS_SEQ set SEQVALUE = SEQVALUE+1 where SEQDATE = #{seqdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SEQCODE = #{seqcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
